zh: 山嶺在霧社的雲霧中迤邐
en: The mountain ridge winds on through the clouds and mist of Wushe
The alpine cherry has not yet bloomed
The stone statue of Mona Rudao
Standing alone in the morning light of March

zh: 在我們會聚的樹蔭下盪開
迴旋於雲霧蒸騰的山谷
en: "All the warriors have already died
Only a few women and children remain
This monumental, sky-sized transformation
Who dares say it arose in a single moment?
Lai He's elegy of the southern land
Rippling out beneath the shade where we gathered
Circling through a valley steaming with cloud and mist

zh: 踏上的卻是歷史斑駁的古道“
濁水溪至今猶流著混濁的水
en: "Our footsteps are fine and scattered
yet what one treads is an ancient road mottled by history
History's ancient road
Intertwined and tangled like cursive script
Recounting gently and indirectly
The bloody, tearful tragedy of ethnic strife
Tragedy repeats and repeats again
The Zhuoshui River still flows murky to this day

zh: 答案啊，隨山風處處飄盪
答案啊，隨山風處處飄盪
en: "How to blend
One person's compassion
Becoming the great love of a people?
How to link together
One person's noble aspiration
Becoming the noble will of a people?“
The question spreads out from beneath the tree's shade
The answer, ah, drifts everywhere on the mountain wind
The answer, ah, drifts everywhere on the mountain wind

zh: 静静地躺在群山萬壑間
澄澈的湖水是我的心情
起伏的山勢是我的意志
en: Leaving Wushe
The clear jade-green lake
Lying quietly amid mountains and ravines beyond count
The mountain breeze blows gently
Suddenly, hearing
Mona Rudao's response ---
The clear lake water is my state of mind
The rise and fall of the mountains is my will
